Switzerland defeats Colombia on penalties to reach World Cup quarter-finals

Switzerland has advanced to the FIFA World Cup quarter-finals after defeating Colombia in a penalty shootout. The match was a Round of 16 tie, with Switzerland securing their first quarter-final appearance since 1954. They will now face Argentina, who previously beat Egypt in their own Round of 16 match.
